title: Centroid of a Semicircle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the centroid of the upper semicircle y = sqrt(R^2 - x^2) on [-R, R].

steps.title: Determine x-bar by Symmetry
steps.explanation: The semicircle is symmetric about the y-axis.

steps.title: Area of Semicircle
steps.explanation: Half the area of a circle of radius R.

steps.title: Evaluate Moment M_x and y-bar
steps.mathExpression: M_x = \frac{1}{2} \int_{-R}^R (R^2 - x^2) dx = \int_0^R (R^2 - x^2) dx = \left[ R^2 x - \frac{x^3}{3} \right]_0^R = \frac{2R^3}{3}; \quad \bar{y} = \frac{M_x}{A} = \frac{2R^3/3}{\pi R^2/2} = \frac{4R}{3\pi}
